images.prompt:
Create ONE finished premium Xiaohongshu campaign poster for 一页映 personal website design service. Portrait 3:4, target 1080x1440 or larger same ratio. Card 01 of 06. Audience: ordinary people who may want a beautiful personal résumé/portfolio website. The image should make them imagine owning their own website.

Image 1 is a REAL desktop website screenshot. Image 2 is its REAL mobile screenshot after the latest responsive update. These are content references for the product screens, not art to reinterpret. Preserve the name 胡海燕, the exact bird-and-fruit painting, the red personal seal, Chinese typography, light paper-colored layout, and the real website content. Do not invent additional artwork, change the person, or substitute a different UI. This is a website design advertisement; 一页映 made the WEBSITE, not the traditional artworks.

ART DIRECTION: refined contemporary Chinese editorial design. Warm ivory #f5f2ea background, deep ink #282b28 headline, restrained cinnabar #914738 accents and naturally soft shadows. Subtle paper tactility, NOT heavy grain, no decorative ink splashes, no mountains, no flowers outside the product screens, no stationery props, no ancient scroll costumes. A modern web design studio with an art-book sensibility. Sparse confident composition. 6% safe margins. Main title extremely legible on a phone: tasteful medium-weight Chinese Song/Ming headline around 90px at1080 width; supporting modern sans text around 30px. Tiny footer should still be readable.

COMPOSITION: top 27% holds type, large screen composition occupies the middle/lower 62%. One very large, almost front-facing elegant desktop browser panel displays image1, with minimal neutral chrome and absolutely NO address bar or URL. A slim smaller phone at lower-right displays image2, placed so it does not cover 胡海燕 or the main bird painting on the large screen. Make the desktop content usefully large. No branded hardware, no keyboard, no angled unreadable perspective, no screenshot inside multiple nested cards. Understated framing and gentle realistic depth. This is one poster, not six thumbnails.

EXACT POSTER TEXT:
small top line: “一页映 · 个人网站定制”
large headline on TWO lines: “把简历做成” / “自己的线上画廊”
subtitle: “胡海燕 · 书法与美育作品集”
small secondary caption below composition: “电脑与手机，都有自己的好看”
footer: “网页设计与制作：一页映”
footer secondary line: “书画素材由本人提供”
bottom-right pagination: “01 / 06”

Only these poster-level text strings; website screenshot content may remain within screens. No QR codes, contact information, prices, fabricated URL, testimonials, performance claims, authorization claims or extra badges. Retain precise Chinese words. Deliver a polished publication-ready SINGLE portrait poster.
